CRM notes / customer voice:
- SMB e-comm SaaS — chat-based pre-sales & order-tracking bot.
- Primary ask: hosted API that scales during traffic bursts (promos, email drops).
- Quote: "When our Friday promo goes live we see sudden 100-500 RPS bursts; users hit 429 and abandon chat." — Product lead
- Current stack: front-end -> serverless proxy -> Redwood hosted API (testing). Proxy uses 4 concurrent connections per region.
- Observed behavior: intermittent 429s and raised latency during 3x spikes; want per-api-key burst allowance and graceful backoff options.
- Targets: p95 latency <700ms for chat, sustain 50 rps baseline, handle bursts up to 500 rps for 30s windows.
- Cost sensitivity: prefer cheaper model routing for non-critical fallback (1/3 token cost).
- Desired features: token-level cost visibility, per-route quotas, soft quota warnings, webhook for quota near-limit, configurable retry-backoff policy for 429s.
- Security: will use SSO for admin; require audit logs for API key usage; SOC2 acceptable for hosted.
- POC plan: run 3 traffic profiles next week (baseline 50rps, spike 250rps x30s, extreme 500rps x20s). Need clear success criteria: <5% 429s, auto-fallback to cheaper model when latency >threshold.
- Internal champion: Sarah Lin (CTO) — pragmatic, small infra team.
- Risk: Billing surprises from burst traffic; want caps + notifications.
